description: Image Studio project memory: print the .image-studio brief at session start; on a user complaint, tell the agent to record it with defect add; at stop, block a completion claim. All exit 0 when python3, the script, or a project store is missing.

hooks.command: S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/image-verify/scripts/studio_state.py"; P=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); if [ -n "$P" ] && [ -f "$S" ]; then "$P" "$S" hook session-start 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0

S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/image-verify/scripts/studio_state.py"; P=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); if [ -n "$P" ] && [ -f "$S" ]; then "$P" "$S" hook prompt 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0

S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/image-verify/scripts/studio_state.py"; P=$(command -v python3 || command -v python); if [ -n "$P" ] && [ -f "$S" ]; then "$P" "$S" hook stop 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
